intro.text: A lighteyed woman in the Alethi warcamps on the Shattered Plains whom Adolin Kholin courted.

items.text: After Adolin stopped courting Deeli, he courted two other women and Janala Lustow before taking up with Rilla. They fell out when she learned he was still seeing Janala. Renarin scolded Adolin over how he had treated her, and Adolin privately admitted he was to blame.
